sloka: एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च ।कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव ।। ६.१०७.२५ ।।
transliteration: enamāpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca ।kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścinnāvasīdati rāghava ।। 6.107.25 ।।

translations.english: "O Raghava! Anyone praying to him will surely not experience grief in straits, in difficulties, in the woods and in times of fear.
